name: rtl-anywhere
description: Userscript that makes any text on any website right-to-left with one shortcut.
author: sadeqi-ah

scripts.dev:harness: node build.mjs && echo 'Open test/harness.html in a browser'
scripts.check: prettier --check . && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test test/*.test.ts && node build.mjs
